BrochureContent.Content:
No. 54 Fearann Ri Doughiska is a top class 4 bedroom home, ready to move straight into. Brilliantly located close to schools, church, supermarkets, Galway Clinic, Parkmore Tech Complex, and is only 5/6 minutes from city centre,

No. 54 is in excellent condition and is fully double glazed. It has gas central heating, a lovely en-suite off master bedroom, an excellent utility room, and a downstairs WC and WHB. The kitchen is fully fitted with a hob, oven, washing machine, and dryer. Lovely spacious rear garden.

No. 54 comprises of an entrance hallway, sitting room, kitchen/ dining room, utility room, downstairs WC and WHB, 4 excellent bedrooms, all with built in units, en-suite off master bedroom, and a main bathroom WC and WHB.

This is a really fantastic opportunity to acquire a lovely home in a location very close to all amenities. 

Full details and viewing with John Quinn on 091 569 174.
